entropy_replay_theorem.claim_scope: explicit frozen bucket subsets and target-coupled offset replay; not an arithmetic-circuit or algebraic-elimination lower bound
entropy_replay_theorem.exact_replay_consequence: Restoring constant target success requires B^(delta-o(1)) disjoint masks, offsets, or retries unless a constraint is forced by the target equation or a compact selector covers one source for every attained endpoint.
exceptions: a target-forced algebraic constraint with no entropy loss
a compact source section covering every attained endpoint
a representation-specific solver whose work is not accepted-source enumeration
entropy_replay_theorem.static_subset_bound: A frozen accepted subset containing M canonical sources covers at most M target endpoints. If M=B^(5-delta), its average target success density is at most B^(-delta+o(1)).
